name: Booth 2008: six circumcerebral patterns, clockwise (32.5 min)
origin: Booth, Koren & Persinger (Laurentian University), circumcerebral "Octopus" ring; patterns from the lab's six-configuration table (Persinger, Tsang, Booth & Koren 2008)
summary: The clockwise arm of Booth 2008: the six ring configurations of the lab's table (three with burst-firing, three with the Thomas pattern), 5 min each with 30 s without field between them. Twelve people took part, six per direction; the paper reports more theta power during the Thomas pattern with the 20 ms base.
notes: Each group received one direction only; this one started over the right prefrontal region (Booth 2008 p.4 [429]). EEG was taken for 20 s, 2.5 min into each pattern (p.3 [428]). Booth reads the table's change in rate with + as shorter: 20 ms falling to 6 ms, 200 ms rising to 214 ms, and for the 100 ms row 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, 1, 1, 1 ms (p.4 [429]). This program plays the six configurations in the table's order, one coil at a time, clockwise from Fp2 round the right side to Fp1. A dwell is written as start, step and end, so the 100 ms row plays 100, 80, 60, 40, 20 ms and starts again: the 1 ms of the last three positions cannot be written, and with five values on eight coils the 100-ms step lands on a different coil at each turn. Cook 1999 describes the same table with the opposite sign (100, 120, 140 ms ..., p.3 [63]); the papers do not settle which of the two the lab's software ran, and persinger-cook-1999-time-cw plays Cook's reading. The burst-firing point values were never published as numbers and the paper gives no point count, so the burst is the project's rising sweep (230 points) with the table's point duration. The Thomas pattern is the 849-point table of US 6,234,953. The lab's ring had two solenoids per position, this helmet has one coil; the site names are this project's reading. The paper gives 5 to 10 uT at the level of the skull (p.3 [428]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Single lab, six people per direction, no sham arm.
setting: Seated, eyes covered, quiet room. One coil per position where the lab's ring had two.
